bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for a charter school in the Lower Sioux Indian Community.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; LOWER SIOUX INDIAN COMMUNITY.

$808,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of education for a grant to the Lower Sioux Indian Community in Redwood County for predesign and design of a Dakota language immersion birth through grade 4 public charter school. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $808,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of education for a grant to the Lower Sioux Indian Community in Redwood County for predesign and design of a Dakota language immersion birth through grade 4 public charter school. This appropriation is onetime and is available until the project is completed or abandoned, subject to Minnesota Statutes, section 16A.642.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
